title: Security
items: The system and its resources from internal and external interference, including unauthorized access
System Security 保護系統與資源，防止未授權存取，並提供 Event 通知與 Audit。
Which item is part of data security rather than system security?
Encryption of data at rest and in flight
Data Security 保護系統上的資料，包括 Encryption、Safeguarded Snapshot 與 Portset Isolation。
How do portsets contribute to data security?
By logical port isolation that restricts the SAN paths for host login traffic
Portset 以 Logical Port Isolation 限制 Host 登入流量可用的 SAN 路徑。
Which authentication methods can users use to log in?
Local accounts, LDAP, SSO, or MFA
使用者可用本機帳號、LDAP 遠端驗證、Single Sign-on 或 Multifactor Authentication 登入。
What determines the role of a local user?
The user group to which the user belongs
本機使用者必須屬於某個 User Group，由 User Group 決定角色與可執行操作。
What is required for a local user to use the management GUI?
使用 GUI 需要 Password；SSH 登入 CLI 則需 Password 或有效 SSH Key。
How are local user passwords stored?
本機使用者的 Password 以 PBKDF2 雜湊儲存。
With remote authentication, where are user credentials stored?
遠端驗證的憑證存放在外部 LDAP Server，使用者不必先在系統上建立，但需建立對應 User Group。
With single sign-on (SSO), who handles the first and second authentication factors?
SSO 將所有驗證委派給受信任的 Identity Provider，第一與第二因素都由 IdP 處理。
Which services can MFA integrate with?
IBM Security Verify or Duo Security
MFA 可整合 IBM Security Verify 或 Duo Security，以不同類別因素 (所知、所有) 驗證使用者。
With the MFA failmode parameter set to secure, what happens if the authentication server is unavailable?
failmode 為 secure 時驗證伺服器無法使用就拒絕登入；insecure 則允許登入。
Since which version does the system include a built-in root CA for internally signed certificates?
自 8.5.3 起內建 Root CA，Internally Signed 憑證較簡單且可自動更新。
Where must a certificate signing request (CSR) be generated for an externally signed certificate?
On the system; CSRs generated outside the system are not supported
CSR 必須在系統上產生，不支援在系統外產生的 CSR。
What happens when you update the internally signed certificate?
The current GUI session is logged out
更新 Internally Signed 憑證會登出目前的 GUI 工作階段。
Which key server does NOT support chain of trust, requiring the new certificate to be exported to it?
Guardium Key Lifecycle Manager 不支援 Chain of Trust，更新憑證後需把新憑證匯出到 Key Server。
What are the default security protocol levels on new systems?
新系統預設 SSL Security Level 5、SSH Security Level 3，可分別調整。
What is the configurable range for SSH login grace time?
SSH Rules：登入寬限時間 15 至 1800 秒，最多登入嘗試 1 至 10 次，預設 SSH Port 22。
What is a partition certificate used for?
Plug-ins or REST API clients accessing a partition
Partition 可有自己的 Partition Certificate，供 Plug-in 或 REST API Client 使用。
Which error indicates that the system SSL certificate has expired?
Event Log 出現 Error 2258 System SSL certificate has expired，需依 Fix Procedure 處理。
Before replacing an expired certificate, what should you check first?
That the system date and time are correct
先確認系統時間與日期正確，錯誤時間會讓憑證被誤判為過期。
After changing the security level, TLS clients cannot connect. What should you do first?
Wait 5 minutes for services to restart
變更 Security Level 後服務需重新啟動，先等 5 分鐘，再確認 Client 是否支援所設定層級。
Which command shows the configured TLS version when browsers report cipher or handshake errors?
Browser 出現 cipher、SSL、TLS 或 handshake 錯誤時，用 `lssecurity` 查看設定。
What is the primary way to reset the superuser password?
The reset password link on the login page, if password reset is enabled
Calling IBM to restore the default password
主要方式是使用登入頁的重設密碼連結 (需已啟用)；也可透過 Technician Port 或 USB Flash Drive。
Can the superuser password be reset to the default password?
superuser 密碼無法重設為預設密碼；若密碼重設功能被停用則沒有替代方法。
Can an unencrypted array be converted to an encrypted array?
No; add encrypted arrays and remove the unencrypted ones
Yes, by enabling encryption on the pool
未加密 Array 無法轉為加密；需新增加密 Array 再移除未加密 Array，資料會自動搬移。
Are arrays that existed before encryption was enabled encrypted?
啟用 Encryption 之後建立的 Array 預設加密；之前已存在的 Array 不加密。
After removing an unencrypted array, what state do its member drives return to?
移除後 Member Drive 回到 candidate，可用來建立新的加密 Array。
Which encryption types are supported depending on the model?
依機型支援 Data-at-rest 與 Data-in-flight Encryption；Data-in-flight 保護 Partnered System 之間的 IP 連線。
簡報 S10；Concept Guide Ch18 Encryption
For new-generation systems on 9.1.2 or later, how is the encryption license provided?
It must be purchased separately and activated
It is downloaded from Storage Insights
9.1.2 以上的新世代系統，Encryption License 於製造時已安裝；舊世代需自行安裝並啟用。
With internal key management, how often is the master key automatically rekeyed?
Internal Key Management 由 Boot Drive 管理 Master Key，每 24 小時自動 Rekey。
Which protocol do key servers use, and how many can be configured?
Key Server 使用 KMIP，最多 4 台，適合多系統環境。
How many copies of the master key must be stored when using USB flash drives?
使用 USB Flash Drive 時，設定時至少要存放 3 份 Master Key。
What is the encryption recovery key?
An ASCII string that supplements other key methods to recover after an outage
A USB key that replaces key servers
Encryption Recovery Key 是 ASCII 字串，用來補充上述任一 Key 管理方式，於中斷後恢復。
Which regulation does secure data deletion comply with?
Secure Data Deletion 符合歐盟規範 EU2019/424。
Which command securely erases a SAS drive?
SAS Drive 使用 `chdrive -task erase`；NVMe Drive 可用 erase 或 format。
What does chdrive -task format do on an NVMe drive?
Changes the drive's internal key and then clears the data
NVMe Drive 的 format 會先更換 Drive 內部 Key 再清除資料。
Which command securely erases a boot drive?
Boot Drive 使用 `satask rescuenode -secureerase -force`，以 Block Erase 清除大部分 VPD。
Which password policy option is NOT supported on FlashSystem 5015, 5035, and 5045?
Requiring a password change at next login
禁止重複使用最近密碼的設定不支援 FlashSystem 5015、5035、5045。
By default, how long are accounts that do not comply with the password policy locked?
未符合規範的帳號預設鎖定 24 小時；superuser 預設不鎖定。
When is a user required to change the password at next login?
When it expires, for new accounts, or after an administrator reset
密碼到期、新帳號或管理員重設時，要求下次登入變更密碼。
How is a high-risk operation performed when TPI is enabled?
One person requests and another approves before it can run
啟用 TPI 後，高風險操作須由一人提出 Role Elevation Request，另一人核准才能執行。
Which CLI command enables Two Person Integrity?
Which task is an example that requires TPI role elevation?
Removing the Safeguarded policy association from a volume group
例：移除 Safeguarded Snapshot、移除 Volume Group 的 Safeguarded Policy 關聯。
Which CHAP hash algorithms are allowed when host authentication FIPS mode is Disabled (default)?
Disabled (預設) 允許 MD5、SHA1、SHA256、SHA3-256；Enabled 僅允許 SHA256 與 SHA3-256。
Which CHAP hash algorithms are disallowed when host authentication mode is Enabled?
Enabled 時禁用 MD5 與 SHA1，只允許 SHA256 與 SHA3-256。
Which systems do NOT support enabling FIPS mode for host authentication?
iSCSI Backend 系統不支援啟用 FIPS 模式。
Can remote users be used to satisfy the TPI requirement of two security administrators?
Yes, if a remote user group with the security administrator role is defined and remote authentication is enabled
TPI 的兩位使用者可為本機、遠端或混合；遠端需定義 Security Administrator 角色的遠端 User Group 並啟用遠端驗證。
Concept Guide Ch18 Two person integrity
Who can approve a role elevation request under TPI?
Another restricted security administrator or a security administrator
角色提升請求須由另一位 Restricted Security Administrator 或 Security Administrator 核准。
What protects partition access with a certificate during HA?
Certificate management only from the Active Management System
Certificates stored in the IP quorum
Partition 處於 HA 時，其憑證管理只能在 Active Management System 進行。
Which internally signed certificate feature can be enabled to avoid expiry?
內部簽署憑證可啟用 Auto-renewal，避免憑證過期。
